items.description: Analyte is a data-driven solutions business that specialises in enhancing operations across sectors including mining, manufacturing, petrochemicals and logistics. Its core offering spans software development, business support, data analytics, process control, simulation, and comprehensive IT and business technology solutions. The company focuses on collecting and curating business data to surface actionable insights and uncover value that many organisations generate but rarely use. Its software is designed to remain future-fit, and it is built to fit alongside a client's existing systems architecture so that onboarding and implementation run smoothly. Analyte also provides ongoing support intended to minimise downtime and resolve conflicts, with support processes built into the solutions it engineers. The firm presents itself as a partner for businesses that want to translate complex process and production data into practical improvements.

items.description: ATS All Technology Solutions (Pty) Ltd is an IT company that began as a hardware supply and support business, building custom computers to match specific client requirements. As its clients' needs evolved, the business grew into a full-service IT provider. Its services cover IT security auditing and implementation, network planning and installation (including Cat 5 and 6, wireless and fibre-optic cabling), network support, hardware support and supply, programming, and server set-up, support and configuration for Linux and Windows environments. The company also offers VOIP (Voice over IP) solutions, internet connection services over ADSL, 3G and wireless, server hosting, website hosting, email services and CCTV. Operating under the slogan 'Unique Requirements, Require Unique Solutions', ATS says it aims to provide a product, service or consultation tailored to each client's best interests, and it offers a free consultation to help businesses define their requirements.

Autoboys Glass Pretoria is a branch of the Autoboys automotive glass network, which the company says has more than 55 outlets across South Africa. The branch offers windscreen repair and replacement, camera and sensor calibration, leak detection, vehicle inspections and EtchGuard. Customers can also order automotive glass online through Takealot, after which Autoboys confirms the glass required, books a date and location, and completes the fitting at the customer's preferred address. Quotes and insurance glass claims are handled through dedicated contact channels, and customers can find their nearest fitment centre through the Autoboys website. The business operates Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and on Saturdays from 08:00 to 13:00, and it is closed on Sundays and public holidays. Autoboys also promotes franchising opportunities for those who want to join its network of automotive glass specialists.

Axon Security Group is a South African security company that describes itself as a leading provider of comprehensive security solutions, with more than 20 years in business. It serves residential, commercial and industrial clients, and says it tailors its services to each client's particular security needs. Its offering includes professional guarding, tactical and armed response, CCTV monitoring and AI surveillance, access control and alarm systems, technical services, a mobile panic app, medical services, investigative services and consulting services. The company's website also welcomes former KPS clients following an acquisition, pointing to additional resources and vehicles to support its services. Its team is described as highly trained and experienced security professionals who are dedicated to the safety of clients at all times.

items.description: BAS Hosting (Pty) Ltd is a 100% black-owned technology business founded in 2011 and based in Villieria, Pretoria. The company provides domain registration, web hosting, website design and development, SSL certificates, SEO services, bulk SMS and IT support. It describes itself as a technology business rather than an agency, building tech solutions intended to be robust and easy to use, with design and coding as its specialities. Its stated goal is to support businesses and individuals both locally and abroad, putting clients' requirements first. All of its hosting plans include free email hosting, with free setup of email accounts on mobile devices and in MS Outlook. The company positions its pricing as affordable, aiming to get a client's website and email live quickly so they can focus on their own customers.

items.description: Best Before Fresh Produce & Grocery is part of a South African retail chain known for selling groceries and household essentials at discounted prices. The chain sells short- and near-dated stock sourced from trusted suppliers, and says nothing it sells is past its use-by date. Best Before was founded in 2017 and began with a pilot store in Wendywood, Sandton, which confirmed demand for cheaper grocery alternatives. The chain then expanded across Johannesburg, with outlets in Woodmead, Edenvale, Fourways, Northcliff, Krugersdorp and Boksburg. Its first Pretoria location opened in the Atterbury Lifestyle Centre in Faerie Glen in October 2024. The Centurion Lifestyle Centre store, where this branch is located, drew thousands of customers within days, reflecting the chain's appeal as an affordable alternative to larger supermarket chains.

Bidvest Protea Coin is a South African security company that delivers integrated, sector-specific security solutions across all market sectors. Its services include guarding and close protection, technical security solution installations and intelligence services, tactical and special operations, K9 units, and airwing and drone support. It also provides off-site monitoring and surveillance from a SAIDSA-accredited control centre. The company says these services can be provided as stand-alone solutions or combined into a total security solution, depending on a customer's risk mitigation strategy or requirement. Bidvest Protea Coin works across sectors including critical infrastructure, mining, technology solutions and niche markets, and it also offers specialised services and security risk management consultancy.

Big Box Containers is part of a container business whose history stretches back to 1997, when the Big Box Containers side of the company was founded. It expanded its offerings within Gauteng in 2007, acquired Container Agents Pretoria in 2017, and launched a single-phase refrigerated container in 2019. In 2023, Container Conversions (Pty) Ltd acquired Big Box Containers (Pty) Ltd, combining the two businesses' experience in temporary and permanent modular building solutions; the company says the combined experience totals 40 years. Container Conversions traces its own roots to 1985 and received further investment from Imbewu Capital Partners in 2019. The business now offers container rentals, including refrigeration and storage units, as well as container sales covering standard units and conversions. Additional services include transport, export and furniture.

BinCareTakers SA is a bin-cleaning company founded in 2025 and based in Lotus Gardens, Pretoria. It was set up with the goal of making Pretoria's neighbourhoods cleaner, healthier and more hygienic, one bin at a time, and its founder is a young local entrepreneur focused on improving health standards and creating jobs in the community. The company provides bin cleaning to homes, schools and businesses across Pretoria, using eco-friendly chemicals. Pricing starts from R30 per bin, with monthly and once-off cleaning plans, as well as business and school service packages. BinCareTakers SA describes its values as environmental care, community hygiene and affordable, reliable service, committing to punctual and professional work. Its stated aim is to improve hygiene and safety in the areas it serves.

Bindworx (Pty) Ltd is a young but fast-growing printing and finishing company that operates as a trade shop, partnering with printers and keeping cost and manufacturability in mind. Its service range includes transfer foiling, graphic design, digital printing, perfect binding, coil and wire binding, litho printing, DVD and CD printing and duplication, fold and staple finishing, OPP and encapsulation, score and perf, and plastic coil making. The company says it can handle small complex projects as well as large-scale assignments, aiming to deliver timely results that meet deadlines. Its digital printers offer high image quality on both black-and-white and colour work. Bindworx also has an experienced graphic designer with 20 years of experience who helps clients with basic design and layout, creating a distinctive corporate look for stationery, annual reports, yearbooks, diaries and workbooks.

Bioworx (Pty) Ltd is a health products company focused on gut health and immune support. Its approach centres on intestinal dysbiosis, an imbalance in gut bacteria that can follow overuse of antibiotics, chlorine residues in drinking water and stress. That imbalance can allow the yeast-like organism Candida to overgrow and weaken the immune system. The company's UMKHONTO product is positioned as a supplement that can be used regularly and on a permanent basis to help inhibit Candida; it contains a probiotic along with immune-boosting vitamins and minerals. Bioworx organises its information around microbial imbalance, digestive disorders, immunity, and gut-health and immune-boosting protocols, and sells its products through an online store. The website notes that the causes of dysbiosis cannot always be eliminated, which is the reason it promotes a regular supplement approach.

Block Projects is a registered NHBRC builder and member of the Master Builders Association, specialising in high-end residential construction across Gauteng's most prestigious neighbourhoods, including custom homes from Mooikloof to Waterkloof. The company builds for clients who may start with only a vision or with a full set of plans, guiding them from concept through to final key handover. Its stated focus is on precision, craftsmanship and transparency throughout a project. Beyond new luxury homebuilding, Block Projects offers a full spectrum of construction and design services, including interior transformation and renovation work. Clients can book a private consultation to discuss their vision before a project begins, and the company positions itself as a premium construction partner for refined, bespoke living spaces.

Blue Diamond Boutique Hotel is a boutique hotel in Moreleta Park, about 24 km from central Pretoria and 42 km from O.R. Tambo International Airport. Guests have free access to a swimming pool, fitness centre and steam room. Each air-conditioned room includes a flat-screen satellite TV, tea and coffee-making facilities, and a minibar, and the private bathrooms include free toiletries. The Luxury Double Room is a larger option that adds a white French door partition between the bedroom and the private area. On site, the Gemstone Restaurant serves breakfast and lunch daily, with dinner available from Monday to Saturday, and a bar at the pool deck serves light snacks on request. Free Wi-Fi and private parking are available. The hotel is close to several local attractions, including the Moreleta Kloof Nature Reserve, a two-minute drive away, and the Voortrekker Monument, about 30 minutes away by car.

items.description: Business Crew is a financial and business services firm offering an all-encompassing range of solutions tailored to each client's needs. Its services include accounting and bookkeeping, tax advice and SARS consultation, payroll management, human resources, recruitment and specialist recruitment, business profiling, tender and audit preparation, and small business services. Bookkeeping, payroll and tax work can also be outsourced. The firm's team has experience across financial services, retail, insurance, leisure, healthcare, agriculture and education. Business Crew says its priority is to offer professional advice and simple solutions, aiming to increase a client's profitability while saving them time and energy. Its tagline, 'innovation is solved', reflects its focus on practical, client-specific answers to financial and administrative challenges.

BusinessPrint is a printing company situated in Pretoria East, specialising in the printing and finishing of packaging products and commercial materials. The company describes its vision as 'Meeting Expectations', aiming to understand client needs and then deliver premium solutions and services. Its digital printing operation uses numerous digital presses to produce full-colour as well as black-and-white work. Its litho printing services produce magazines, books, direct marketing collateral, cartons, skillets and header cards. Its packaging division uses dedicated equipment to make paper-based header cards, cartons, skillets, display cartons, shipper boxes, labels and package inserts. Together, these three areas make up the core of BusinessPrint's offering for businesses that need both marketing print and functional packaging.

CapeBio is a biotechnology company operating in Africa, offering services across several specialised areas. Its oligonucleotide synthesis service provides custom DNA and RNA synthesis with HPLC purification and stringent quality control. Its diagnostic and IVD work aims to support global health initiatives with reliable, scalable solutions. The company also conducts enzyme discovery, leveraging African biodiversity to uncover novel biomolecules. Its regulatory manufacturing operations are certified to ISO 13485:2016 and aligned with international standards, with GMP validations built into its processes. CapeBio says its values include integrity, accountability, responsible innovation, and diversity and inclusion, and that it combines scientific innovation with regulatory compliance so that its products and services meet international standards for research and clinical applications.

Cariole Media is a full-service media and entertainment agency established in 2019, offering creative solutions for businesses as well as artists. Its services span website development, graphic design, digital and social media marketing, and audio and video production. The company describes its mission as bridging the gap between a good idea and a global audience, giving clients the tools and platform they need to thrive in a digital world. Cariole Media says it aims to offer cutting-edge media services to both fans and artists. The agency presents itself as a team of professionals who help clients achieve their goals through innovative media strategies, from website development to audio production.

items.description: CBC Building Projects is a full-service construction management company with 18 years of experience in the construction industry. It offers turnkey solutions, managing a project from pre-construction planning and design through construction and project closeout. Its services include budgeting, scheduling, procurement, risk management, quality control and safety compliance. Rather than applying a standard approach, the company develops a tailored plan for each client based on that client's specific needs, budget and goals. Its team works closely with clients throughout the process to keep them informed and involved at every stage. The company says communication is central to the success of any project, and it is dedicated to delivering each project on time, within budget and to a high standard of quality.

Centbiz is an IT and retail solutions provider that supplies hardware and software for small and medium-sized businesses, whether they are just starting out, already trading or looking to upgrade. Its retail offering is built around its own Ultisales point-of-sale software. The company also supplies refurbished computers and provides internet security through ESET Internet Security. Its networking services cover fibre, cabling and switches, and its website design work extends to advertising and e-commerce. Centbiz positions itself as a leader in all of its IT and retail solutions, aiming to supply businesses with high-quality hardware and software and to help clients get their business started or grow it.

Centurion Country Club Restaurant is a relaxed, cosy dining spot in Centurion Golf Estate with a warm fireplace and a diverse menu. The restaurant offers dine-in service, outdoor seating and takeout, and it accepts reservations for groups and special occasions. An on-site bar serves cocktails, wine, beer, spirits and other drinks, and the venue also lists coffee and small plates alongside its main menu. Vegan and vegetarian dishes are available, and the restaurant has a kids' menu and high chairs, with its listing noting that it is good for children's birthdays. The restaurant is open daily from 06:00 to 22:00. Accessibility features include a wheelchair-accessible entrance, parking lot, seating and restroom, and card payments are accepted.

items.description: CHOPROP is a South African-based real estate group that handles sales and lettings of residential, commercial, retail, industrial, agricultural and mixed-use property. Its listings also include student accommodation and farms and smallholdings. Beyond property transactions, CHOPROP runs real estate training for people who want to pursue a career in the industry. This includes a two-day online 'Become a Property Guru' intensive workshop, as well as a digital learning programme delivered as a ten-module DVD set. Testimonials on the company's website describe its team as responsive and efficient in handling tenant placements, property preparation and the handover of keys. The company positions itself both as a full-service property agency and as a resource for new entrants to the sector.

CiviTech Civil Design Services cc is a specialist firm offering civil engineering and project management services. The practice is based in Murrayfield, Pretoria, with easy access by major road systems to all the centres where its projects are located. Its founding member has been involved in the civil engineering industry for more than 30 years and is registered with the Engineering Council of South Africa. CiviTech's areas of expertise include building engineering services, bulk earthworks, bulk stormwater management, and bulk water supply for both rural and highly developed areas. It also covers flood line investigations, mine roads and infrastructure, outfall sewers, petrol service stations, provincial roads, and pump stations for clean and soiled water. Further work includes reservoirs, roads and parking areas, and township services for low- to high-income areas.

CKR Consulting Engineers is a multi-disciplinary engineering firm that describes its approach as intelligent, agile, multi-layered and integrated, aimed at turning innovative ideas into viable solutions. Its services span electrical engineering, electronic engineering, mechanical engineering, fire protection and wet services, and civil and structural engineering. The firm also offers high voltage engineering and renewable energy services, as well as IT infrastructure engineering. CKR publishes a company profile and client list, lists its accreditations and awards, and has a BBBEE section on its website. Its business is built around combining these engineering disciplines so that clients can draw on several specialisms within one firm.

Clean Stream Biological Services is an environmental science firm specialising in the biological monitoring of aquatic ecosystems, including biodiversity assessments and bioaccumulation studies. It also conducts focused toxicity testing as a biomonitoring tool, in conjunction with its sister company, Biotox Laboratory Services. Its main client base includes South Africa's mining industry, other industries, municipalities, government, private developers and consultants. The team includes scientists with qualifications ranging from PhD to B.Tech. Those responsible for biomonitoring programmes are DWS-accredited SASS5 practitioners, while senior scientists and management are registered professional scientists with the South African Council for Natural Scientific Profession (SACNASP). Collectively, the team has more than 40 years of combined experience in environmental monitoring.

Click Results is a Pretoria web design and SEO company that uses a five-step process to turn a client's website into a marketing tool that attracts new clients. It targets business owners who feel they are losing clients and sales to competitors, or who have spent money with large agencies without seeing results. Its services include StoryBrand-style website design and search engine optimisation. It cites research showing that 75% of consumers judge a company's credibility based on its website design, that 57% of internet users would not recommend a business with a poorly designed mobile website, and that 38% of people stop engaging with a site when its content or layout is unattractive. The company operates Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16:30.

items.description: ClickSupport is an IT solutions provider that works on the principle that technology should empower businesses rather than complicate them. It helps organisations of all sizes make use of reliable, secure and scalable technology. Its expertise spans managed IT services, cloud and Microsoft 365 solutions, cybersecurity and compliance, and infrastructure and networking. The company describes its approach as proactive, focusing on prevention rather than reaction, and it aims to build long-term partnerships so that clients can focus on what they do best. Its stated values are partnership, innovation, integrity, excellence and reliability. ClickSupport's mission is to deliver secure, reliable and scalable technology solutions that empower business growth, and its vision is to become a globally recognised IT partner known for innovation, reliability and measurable impact.
